verdict.rationale: Marqeta ships an official MCP Server that lets external AI agents query Core API data, issue virtual cards, and set spend controls, which indirectly enables natural-language operation via a connected agent — but this requires the user's own AI agent tooling rather than a built-in NL interface, and there's no evidence of a native chat/NL command surface in the product itself. missing for 10: evidence of a first-party natural-language interface/chat UI, independent/hands-on confirmation of NL command usage via the MCP server, and broader coverage beyond the limited endpoint set mentioned.
